variants.headline: Looking back: a new government takes shape
variants.sub: The colony has a new government comprising {members}.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: A new government comprising {members} had been formed.

Our principles do not become less demanding when an administration is assembled. Government ought to be a means of advancing convictions through responsible action. The attraction of holding office is no substitute for an account of what office is for, and whose interests it should serve.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

The position of {target} should be assessed through the responsibilities of formation without a verdict on decisions not yet established by this report. A new government is a fact, not a forecast.

variants.headline: Looking back: formation is the beginning of governing
variants.sub: Government formation has produced an administration comprising {members}.
variants.body:
Looking back to {first_reported}, this was the news: The colony had a new government comprising {members}.

Our principles do not become less demanding when an administration is assembled. Government ought to be a means of advancing convictions through responsible action. The attraction of holding office is no substitute for an account of what office is for, and whose interests it should serve.

Time changes the distance from an event, not the need to judge it carefully. Any claim about improvement or deterioration needs more than a recollection of the original news.

The position of {target} should be assessed through the responsibilities of formation without a verdict on decisions not yet established by this report. A new government is a fact, not a forecast.

variants.headline: Looking back: new ministry, practical obligations
variants.sub: A new government comprising {members} has been formed.
variants.body:
The headline belongs to {first_reported}. Our original account recorded this: Government formation had produced an administration comprising {members}.

Our principles do not become less demanding when an administration is assembled. Government ought to be a means of advancing convictions through responsible action. The attraction of holding office is no substitute for an account of what office is for, and whose interests it should serve.

What has changed since then should be examined against that original record. What has not changed is the need to distinguish an established event from the hopes or fears attached to it.

The position of {target} should be assessed through the responsibilities of formation without a verdict on decisions not yet established by this report. A new government is a fact, not a forecast.
